g.text: Following the evidence: the 10:14 incident, step by step
Report (high confidence): ACME started sending PutOrCall as C/P instead of 0/1 after reconnecting at 10:01 -
most likely a client-side engine upgrade. Nothing changed on our side.
Evidence: seq 14 @ 10:03:41 rejected 373=5 on 201; 37 identical rejects. Next: contact ACME; interim override per runbook.
Never called: order state, business rules, broker deep-dive. The evidence pointed at the message layer, so it stopped there.
